rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §13's root cause matches the cited code exactly: `routing.require_plan_reviewed` still collects `plan_review.unanswered_findings(record)` plan-wide and says in its own comment that "a finding's identity names no unit, so an unanswered one cannot be attributed to the caller's scope" (routing.py:2735–2760), so the plan-wide hold §13 describes is real. §14's root cause also holds: the code at HEAD carries `--acted` and `--declined` on the answer command and no `--note`. §15's mechanism does not hold together, and §13's does so only at read time.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §13 carries one deliverable (attribute each finding to a unit and gate on it), §14 one (require and store a note on an acted answer), §15 one (scope a review round and carry the scoped history). Each done-when asserts that one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` resolves: s14 → s13, s15 → s13 and s14, and every id named is in `plan-section-declarations` (plan.html:25). s15's waits are the right ones: it consumes the per-unit attribution §13 adds and the answer note §14 adds.
